Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver
public class GameController extends Object implements GameObserver
Server-side MVC controller. - Holds the nickname → VirtualView map - Receives client actions, validates them, and delegates them to the model (Game class) - Implements GameObserver: translates model notifications into callbacks to clients - buildExtraInfo() builds the "info panel" sent to the current player (better here for direct connection to the Player class)

    • GameController

      public GameController(Game game, boolean recovering, List<String> savedBotNicknames)
      Constructor for games restored from disk that had active bots. Nicknames in savedBotNicknames do not need to reconnect: they are automatically recreated as Bot instances once all real players have returned.
      Parameters:
      game - the restored game model
      recovering - whether the game is in recovery mode
      savedBotNicknames - nicknames that were represented by bots at crash time

    • onTurnStarted

      public void onTurnStarted(String nickname, GameState phase)
      The model tells us who must act and in which phase. Strategy: 1. Build a full board snapshot and broadcast it to ALL non-active players via onTurnSnapshot. This keeps every waiting player informed of the current game state. 2. Send the detailed action panel (available cards, player's own hand) only to the active player.
      Specified by:
      onTurnStarted in interface GameObserver
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player whose turn it is
      phase - the current GameState phase

    • onPlayerDisconnected

      public void onPlayerDisconnected(String nickname)
      Called by LobbyManager when a client connection drops unexpectedly. If real players remain, the disconnected player's VirtualView is replaced by a BotVirtualView that continues the game with random choices. If NO real players remain, the game is marked as aborted and the lobby will be removed by LobbyManager.

    • isBotPlayer

      public boolean isBotPlayer(String nickname)
      Returns true if the player with the given nickname is currently represented by a Bot rather than a real network client. Used by LobbyManager to prefer lobbies where the player is still a real client.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      Returns:
      true if a Bot is acting on behalf of this nickname
